thread:
elaine: Deploybot failed to publish prod image from staging during the 21:00 PST change window. ECR rejected the push with a large annotation/attestation payload. We need a quick fallthrough decision: push without attestation (fast), retag with trimmed attestation (manual, ~20m), or abort promotion and roll back the pipeline.

deploybot: automatic message: promotion failed. details below.
```
PUT /v2/redwood/app/manifests/latest 400 Bad Request
AnnotationPayloadTooLarge: annotations size 128128 > 65536
Request ID: r-efg-987
Image: registry.redwood.local/redwood/app:staging-2026-03-21-9bcded
Build: build-20260321-9222
Attestation keys count: 18
```

devops: if we push without the cosign attestation, we lose the convenience of the in-repo provenance for this promotion, but prod will get the new image. We can add a short manual audit entry linking to CI artifacts.

leo: Retagging with a trimmed attestation is the safer long term move, but it looks like our trimming script isn't baked into CI yet. Manual retag will need me or infra to run `ci/publish --trim-annotations` which will take ~15-25m. That might miss the change window if we wait.

nina: How urgent is this deploy? any block for customer SLA? If not urgent, prefer safe retag.

release-eng: No active outage. This is a normal release; we prefer correctness over rushing. Suggest delay promotion by 30m to allow retag + sanity checks. Also update release notes accordingly.

infra: FYI the limit hit is triggered by embedding long CI logs and the full commit log in the cosign annotations. We should not shove >64KB into annotations. I'll open INFRA-5433 to enforce annotation size checks in the publish pipeline.

gavin: Alternative: publish with a minimal attestation (only commit+buildid+short summary) using `--attestation-minimal` flag we added to the experimental publisher. It was tested but not turned on for the default pipeline. That would be ~5m and keep an attestation, so it's a nice compromise.

elaine: ok decision: use minimal attestation now to hit the window, then schedule a follow-up to republish a fully-attested artifact under a new tag (staging-2026-03-21-9bcded-fullattest) and deprecate the minimal one once verified. @gavin can you run `deploybot publish --from-staging staging-2026-03-21-9bcded --attestation-minimal`? Also add a release note: "Promotion used minimal attestation due to ECR size limit; full provenance will be backfilled."

deploybot: Received command: `publish --from-staging staging-2026-03-21-9bcded --attestation-minimal`. Attempting promotion.

deploybot: promotion success. image pushed as registry.redwood.local/redwood/app:staging-2026-03-21-9bcded (minimal attestation). Rollout initiated.

release-eng: I'll add the blurb to the release notes and ping the small set of customers who requested full provenance in the past.

infra: INFRA-5433 created: "enforce attestation size gate in CI and add trimming/flag options to publisher". Also add a follow-up for a library to compress/stream attestation payloads.

leo: After the window I'll run the republish job to create `staging-2026-03-21-9bcded-fullattest` with full provenance and then mark `staging-2026-03-21-9bcded` as shadowed by the fullattest tag once validated. I'll post status here.

nina: thanks, team. small note: let's document the `--attestation-minimal` flag in the runbook so oncall knows the safe fallback.

elaine: closing decision: minimal attestation fallback used to preserve change window; infra ticket and republish planned. Reopen if any customer concerns. :white_check_mark:
